summary: Hercules Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Eleventh Supplemental Indenture for a public offering of $325 million aggregate principal amount of 6.300% Notes due 2031. The unsecured notes mature July 24, 2031, pay interest semiannually, and rank pari passu with existing unsecured liabilities. The company may redeem at par plus a make-whole premium. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
